source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 5 (PDF 130-142), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Enzymes) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is metabolism? What regulates it?
(Metabolism kya hai? Ise kaun control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jaandaron mein hone wali tamam chemical sargarmiyon ka majmua metabolism hai. Ise enzymes control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The sum of all chemical activities occurring in living organisms i.e., metabolism is regulated by enzymes

blocks.prompt:
2 Why is it said that without enzymes there would be no life?
(Kyun kaha jata hai ke enzymes ke baghair zindagi na hoti?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke enzymes reactions ko bohat tez (10³ se 10⁸ guna) karte hain. Jo reaction enzyme ke saath 30 minute mein ho, woh baghair enzyme ke aik saal leta, jo zindagi ke liye bohat dheema hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, we can say that without enzymes there would have been no life at all

blocks.prompt:
3 Where are enzymes synthesized, and where do they work?
(Enzymes kahan bante hain aur kahan kaam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tamam enzymes cells ke andar ribosomes banate hain. Phir woh ya to cell ke andar kaam karte hain (jaise glycolysis ke enzymes cytoplasm mein; protein synthesis ke enzymes ribosomes ka hissa) ya bahar bhej diye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: After their synthesis, either they stay and work inside cell or they are secreted out to work at other sites

blocks.prompt:
4 Why is pepsin produced in an inactive form?
(Pepsin ghair fa'al shakal mein kyun banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pepsin proteins hazam karta hai aur apne banane wale cells ke protein structures tabah kar sakta hai. Is liye ghair fa'al pepsinogen banta hai, bahar bheja jata hai aur apni jagah par pepsin ban kar fa'al hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It can destroy protein-made structures present inside cells where it is synthesized

blocks.prompt:
5 Why can only a certain substrate fit into an enzyme's active site?
(Enzyme ki active site mein sirf aik khaas substrate hi kyun fit hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke har active site ki shakal bohat makhsoos hai; yeh teen jihati hai aur khaas charge rakhti hai, is liye sirf aik khaas substrate us mein fit hota hai.

book_ref.quote: So, only a certain substrate molecule can fit into it

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between binding site and catalytic site.
(Binding site aur catalytic site mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono active site ke hisse hain:

book_ref.quote: Catalytic site catalyses the reaction and substrate is transformed into products

rows: Woh hissa jis mein substrate fit hota hai
Woh hissa jo reaction karata hai
Substrate ko kamzor quwwaton (hydrogen bonds) se pakarta hai
Substrate ko products mein badalta hai

blocks.prompt:
7 Differentiate between apoenzyme and holoenzyme.
(Apoenzyme aur holoenzyme mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein cofactor shamil hone ka farq hai:

book_ref.quote: The protein part of enzyme is called apoenzyme

blocks.prompt:
8 How do metal ions act as cofactors? Name three such ions.
(Metal ions cofactors ke taur par kaise kaam karte hain? Teen ions ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ca⁺², Mg⁺², Mn⁺², Cu⁺² aur Zn⁺² jaise metal ions enzymes ki ghair fa'al active sites ko fa'al banate hain. In ke judne se enzyme ki shakal badalti hai aur woh substrate se mil sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Many enzymes use metal ions, such as Ca⁺², Mg⁺², Mn⁺², Cu⁺², and Zn⁺² as their cofactors

blocks.prompt:
9 How do coenzymes take part in enzyme-catalysed reactions?
(Coenzymes enzyme wale reactions mein kaise hissa lete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Coenzymes aksar electrons (hydrogen atoms) aik enzyme se doosre tak le ja kar reactions mein hissa lete hain. Bohat se vitamins, jaise niacin aur riboflavin, coenzymes ka kaam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Coenzymes participate in enzyme-catalysed reactions, often by transporting electrons

blocks.prompt:
10 What is the role of NAD⁺ when food is oxidized in a cell?
(Cell mein khurak ke oxidation ke waqt NAD⁺ ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: NAD⁺ hydrogen acceptor hai. Enzymes khurak ke molecules se electrons le kar NAD⁺ ko dete hain jo NADH ban jata hai. NADH hydrogen atom ke electron ki energy uthata hai.

book_ref.quote: The electron of hydrogen atom contains energy that NADH molecule carries

blocks.prompt:
11 Why are trace elements like molybdenum and manganese necessary for health?
(Molybdenum aur manganese jaise trace elements sehat ke liye kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke enzymes molybdenum aur manganese jaise trace elements ko cofactors ke taur par istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: which are necessary for our health, are used by enzymes as cofactors

blocks.prompt:
12 How do enzymes lower the activation energy?
(Enzymes activation energy kaise kam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Enzymes reactants ko durust rukh mein ikattha karte hain ya un ke khaas bonds par dabao daalte hain. Is liye naye bonds ke liye kam activation energy chahiye aur reaction tez ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Enzymes bring reactants together in correct orientation or stress particular chemical bonds of reactants

blocks.prompt:
13 Do enzymes change the products of a reaction? Give an example.
(Kya enzymes reaction ke products badalte hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Enzymes products ki nau'iyat ya khususiyaat nahi badalte. Misaal: sucrose hamesha glucose aur fructose mein tootta hai, sucrase ho ya na ho; sucrase sirf use tez karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The presence of enzymes does not affect the nature or properties of end products

blocks.prompt:
14 What is the ES complex? What happens after it forms?
(ES complex kya hai? Is ke banne ke baad kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: ES (enzyme-substrate) complex tab banta hai jab substrate active site se judta hai. Catalytic site fa'al ho kar substrate ke bonds par dabao daalti aur unhen kamzor karti hai, activation energy kam hoti hai aur substrate products banta hai. Phir enzyme bina badle alag ho jata hai: E + S → ES → E + P.

book_ref.quote: The atoms of catalytic site stress and destabilize particular bonds of substrate

blocks.prompt:
15 How do enzymes work in a complex metabolic pathway?
(Pechida metabolic pathway mein enzymes kaise kaam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se enzymes apne cofactors ke saath silsilewar kaam karte hain. Aik enzyme ka product agle ka substrate banta hai, yahan tak ke aakhri products bante hain jo (feedback se) pehle enzyme ko rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: In complex metabolic pathways e.g., respiration, photosynthesis, protein synthesis etc.

blocks.prompt:
16 State the lock-and-key model.
(Lock-and-key model bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Emil Fischer (1894) ne pesh kiya: jaise khaas chabi sirf khaas taala kholti hai, waise hi khaas enzyme sirf aik khaas substrate ko products mein badalta hai. Active site sakht hai, amal se pehle, dauran ya baad koi lachak nahi.

book_ref.quote: as a specific key can open only a specific lock

blocks.prompt:
17 Why was the induced fit model proposed?
(Induced fit model kyun pesh kiya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Baad ki tehqeeq ne lock-and-key model ko tamam reactions mein sahih na paya. Naye saboot par Daniel Koshland (1958) ne kaha ke active site lachakdaar hai aur catalysis se pehle substrate ke judne se badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Later studies did not support lock-and-key model in all reactions

blocks.text: 5.4 Factors affecting the rate of enzyme action

blocks.prompt:
18 Name four factors that affect the rate of enzyme action.
(Enzyme ke amal ki raftaar par asar daalne wale chaar awamil ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Temperature, pH, enzyme ki miqdaar (concentration) aur substrate ki miqdaar.

book_ref.quote: Enzymes are very sensitive to the environment in which they work

blocks.prompt:
19 What is optimum temperature? Give its value for human enzymes.
(Optimum temperature kya hai? Insani enzymes ke liye is ki qeemat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Optimum temperature woh khaas temperature hai jis par enzyme sab se tez kaam karta hai. Insani enzymes ke liye 37 °C.

book_ref.quote: Every enzyme works at its maximum rate at a specific temperature called its optimum temperature

blocks.prompt:
20 Why does a rise in temperature up to a certain limit increase the rate of enzyme action?
(Aik khaas had tak temperature barhne se enzyme ka amal tez kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Garmi activation energy mein izafa karti hai aur substrate aur enzyme molecules ko kinetic energy deti hai, is liye woh tez chalte, zyada takraate hain aur reaction ki raftaar barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: When temperature is raised up to a certain limit, the heat adds in activation energy

blocks.prompt:
21 What is denaturation of an enzyme?
(Enzyme ka denaturation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Optimum se bohat zyada temperature par atoms ki thartharahat itni shadeed hoti hai ke bonds polypeptide chains ko jagah par nahi rakh pate aur globular banawat khatam ho jati hai. Yeh denaturation hai; raftaar tezi se girti aur band ho sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: When vibrations become too violent, bonds cannot hold polypeptide chains in the proper position

blocks.prompt:
22 How can thermophilic bacteria live in hot springs?
(Thermophilic bacteria garam chashmon mein kaise reh lete hain?)
blocks.explanation: In ke proteins mein polypeptide hisson ke darmiyan mazboot bonding hai, is liye un ke enzymes denature nahi hote aur 70 °C ya zyada par kaam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They have proteins with stronger bonding between their polypeptide arms

blocks.prompt:
23 Differentiate between the pH requirements of pepsin and trypsin.
(Pepsin aur trypsin ki pH ki zaroorat mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bohat mukhtalif pH par behtareen kaam karte hain:

book_ref.quote: Every enzyme works its best at a specific pH, called its optimum pH

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is enzyme activity sensitive to pH?
(Enzyme ki activity pH se kyun mutasir hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Enzyme ki polypeptide chains mukhalif charge wale amino acids (jaise glutamic acid – aur lysine +) ke bonds se judi hain jo H⁺ ki miqdaar se mutasir hote hain. pH badalne se active site aur substrate ki ionization badalti hai; intehai tabdeeli enzyme ko denature kar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: These bonds are sensitive to hydrogen ion concentration

blocks.prompt:
25 Name an enzyme that works in both acidic and alkaline media, and give its source.
(Aisa enzyme batayein jo tezabi aur alkaline dono medium mein kaam kare, aur us ka zariya.)
blocks.explanation: Papain, jo kachche papite se milta hai, tezabi aur alkaline dono medium mein kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Some enzymes like papain from green papaya work both in acidic and alkaline media

blocks.prompt:
26 How does the rate of reaction depend on enzyme concentration when substrate is unlimited?
(Substrate la-mehdood ho to reaction ki raftaar enzyme ki miqdaar par kaise munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Raftaar seedhe tor par enzyme ki miqdaar par munhasir hai. Zyada enzyme molecules se zyada active sites milti hain, is liye zyada substrate jud kar products banta hai.

book_ref.quote: The overall rate of enzyme-controlled reactions depends directly on the amount of enzyme present

blocks.prompt:
27 Why does the rate of reaction stop rising when enzyme concentration increases but substrate stays the same?
(Enzyme barhane aur substrate wohi rakhne par reaction ki raftaar barhna kyun ruk jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke mojood tamam substrate pehle hi jud chuka hota hai; izafi enzymes se judne ke liye mazeed substrate nahi bachta, is liye raftaar yaksan rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: no more substrate molecules will attach with enzymes

blocks.prompt:
28 Differentiate between the effect of substrate concentration at low and high levels (enzyme constant).
(Enzyme muqarrar ho to kam aur zyada substrate ke asar mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Enzyme ki miqdaar muqarrar rakhte hue:

book_ref.quote: a point is reached where any further increase in substrate does not increase the rate of reaction any more

rows: Naya substrate khaali jagah se judta hai; waqt mein zyada product
Izafi substrate ko khaali jagah nahi milti

blocks.prompt:
29 What is enzyme inhibition?
(Enzyme inhibition kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik chemical (inhibitor) enzyme se judta hai magar product nahi banta, is liye active sites ko aarzi ya mustaqil band kar deta hai. Is amal ko enzyme inhibition kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Inhibitors attach with enzymes but are not transformed into products

blocks.prompt:
30 How does aspirin suppress pain and inflammation?
(Aspirin dard aur sozish kaise kam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aspirin dawa ke taur par istemal hone wala enzyme inhibitor hai. Yeh prostaglandin banane wale enzymes ko rokti hai jo sozish ka sabab hai; is liye dard aur sozish kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, aspirin suppresses pain and inflammation

blocks.prompt:
31 Why is cyanide a poison?
(Cyanide zehar kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyanide irreversible enzyme inhibitor hai. Yeh cytochrome oxidase ke active site mein copper aur iron se jud kar cellular respiration rok deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The poison cyanide is an irreversible enzyme inhibitor

blocks.prompt:
32 Differentiate between competitive and non-competitive inhibitors on the basis of their site of binding.
(Competitive aur non-competitive inhibitors mein judne ki jagah ki bunyad par farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh enzyme par mukhtalif jagahon par judte hain:

book_ref.quote: Its binding alters the shape of enzyme so that active site does not fit substrate

rows: Substrate se koi asli mushabehat nahi
Active site par substrate se muqabla kar ke judta hai
Active site mein nahi jata; doosri jagah judta hai
Active site band karta hai, substrate nahi jud sakta
Enzyme ki shakal badalta hai, active site substrate se fit nahi hoti

blocks.prompt:
33 Explain the competitive inhibition of succinic dehydrogenase by malonic acid.
(Malonic acid se succinic dehydrogenase ki competitive inhibition samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Succinic dehydrogenase succinic acid ko fumaric acid mein oxidize karta hai. Malonic acid banawat mein succinic acid jaisa hai, is liye dono active site ke liye muqabla karte hain; malonic acid chun liya jaye to active site band ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: So, both of them compete for active site of enzyme

blocks.prompt:
34 How is succinyl-CoA synthetase inhibited by its own product?
(Succinyl-CoA synthetase apne hi product se kaise rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Succinic acid aur CoA mil kar succinyl-CoA banate hain, succinyl-CoA synthetase ki madad se. Product succinyl-CoA non-competitive inhibitor ban kar enzyme se judta hai aur mazeed succinyl-CoA nahi banta.

book_ref.quote: This reaction is catalysed by enzyme succinyl-CoA synthetase

blocks.prompt:
35 How do some antibiotics act as competitive inhibitors?
(Kuch antibiotics competitive inhibitors ke taur par kaise kaam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: In ke molecules bacteria ki zindagi ke liye zaroori enzymes ke substrates se mushabeh hain. Is liye yeh un enzymes ki active sites se jud kar unhen band karte hain aur bacteria mar jate hain. (Book correction: yeh substrates se mushabeh hain, enzymes se nahi.)

book_ref.quote: These antibiotic molecules are similar in structure to the substrates of bacterial enzymes

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate between reversible and irreversible inhibitors.
(Reversible aur irreversible inhibitors mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein enzyme se banne wale bond ka farq hai:

book_ref.quote: depending upon the kind of bond formed between inhibitor and enzyme

rows: Dilution, dialysis ya zyada substrate se alag nahi hote
Alag ho sakte hain; zyada substrate se asar khatam

blocks.prompt:
37 How does malonate slow down cellular respiration?
(Malonate cellular respiration ko kaise dheema karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Malonate reversible inhibitor hai; yeh cellular respiration ke enzyme succinate dehydrogenase ko aarzi rokta hai. Malonate hatane par yeh rukawat khatam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: This inhibition can be reversed when malonate is removed

blocks.prompt:
38 Why does a metabolic pathway need to be shut down? How is it done?
(Metabolic pathway ko band karne ki zaroorat kyun hai? Yeh kaise hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aakhri product ki miqdaar control karne ke liye. Yeh feedback inhibition se hota hai: aakhri product shuru ke enzyme se jud kar us ki shakal badalta hai, woh substrate se nahi jud pata aur pathway band ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In order to regulate the concentration of that product, pathway needs to be shut down

blocks.prompt:
39 Give an example of feedback inhibition involving ATP.
(ATP wali feedback inhibition ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab cell mein zaroorat se zyada ATP ho to ATP khud non-competitive inhibitor ban kar ATP banane wale enzyme ko rok deta hai.

book_ref.quote: blocks the enzyme that catalyses ATP synthesis

blocks.prompt:
40 Give two medical uses of enzyme inhibitors.
(Enzyme inhibitors ke do tibbi istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Bohat si dawaiyan inhibitors hain: antibiotics bacteria ke enzymes aur cancer ki dawaiyan cell division ke enzymes rokti hain.
2. Khoon jamne ke enzymes ke inhibitors anticoagulants ke taur par istemal hote hain. (Zeharon ke asar ko samajhna poisoning ke ilaj mein bhi madad deta hai.)

book_ref.quote: Some toxins and poisons inhibit important enzymes in the body

blocks.prompt:
41 How are enzyme inhibitors useful in research?
(Enzyme inhibitors tehqeeq mein kaise mufeed hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh pharmaceutical tehqeeq ke qeemti aalaat hain jin se khaas enzymes ke kaam aur mumkina dawaiyon ka mutaala hota hai. Inhibition enzyme kinetics ke mutaale ka bhi ahem hissa hai.

book_ref.quote: Enzyme inhibitors serve as valuable tools in pharmaceutical research

blocks.prompt:
42 What are oxidoreductases? Give an example.
(Oxidoreductases kya hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Oxidoreductases H⁺ ions ya electrons jor kar ya nikal kar substrates ka oxidation/reduction karte hain. Misaal: cytochrome oxidase cytochrome ka oxidation karta hai.

book_ref.quote: They add or remove H⁺ ions or electrons from substrates

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate between transferases and lyases.
(Transferases aur lyases mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono groups se mutaliq hain magar mukhtalif tareeqe se:

book_ref.quote: These enzymes catalyse non-hydrolytic addition or removal of groups

rows: Functional group (methyl, acyl, amino, phosphate) aik substrate se doosre ko
Baghair paani ke groups (jaise CO₂, NH₂) jorna ya nikalna
Misaal: hexokinase ATP se glucose ko phosphate deta hai
Misaal: pyruvate decarboxylase pyruvic acid se CO₂ nikalta hai

blocks.prompt:
44 What are isomerases? Give an example.
(Isomerases kya hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Isomerases molecule ke andar tarteeb badal kar aik isomer ko doosre mein badalte hain. Misaal: hexose isomerase glucose ko fructose banata hai.

book_ref.quote: These enzymes catalyse the intra-molecular rearrangement

blocks.prompt:
45 What are proteases? Name two.
(Proteases kya hain? Do ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Proteases proteins ko todte hain. Misalein: pepsin aur trypsin (bare polypeptides ko chhoton mein) aur erepsin (dipeptides ko amino acids mein).

book_ref.quote: This group included the enzymes which catalyse the breakdown of proteins

blocks.prompt:
46 Differentiate between maltase and sucrase.
(Maltase aur sucrase mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono disaccharides par kaam karne wale carbohydrases hain:

book_ref.quote: These enzymes act upon bigger carbohydrates and break them into smaller units

blocks.prompt:
47 What are lipases? Give an example with its products.
(Lipases kya hain? Products ke saath misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Lipases lipids par kaam kar ke unhen todte hain. Misaal: pancreatic lipase lipids ko fatty acids aur glycerol mein todta hai.

book_ref.quote: These enzymes act upon lipids and catalyse their breakdown

blocks.prompt:
48 What are carbohydrases? Give the action of amylase and cellulase.
(Carbohydrases kya hain? Amylase aur cellulase ka amal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Carbohydrases bare carbohydrates ko chhoti units mein todte hain. Amylase starch ya glycogen ko maltose mein; cellulase cellulose ko cellobiose (aik disaccharide) ya glucose mein todta hai.

book_ref.quote: Cellulase breaks cellulose into cellobiose

blocks.prompt:
49 What are ligases? Which bonds do they form?
(Ligases kya hain? Yeh kaun se bonds banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ligases woh enzymes hain jo ATP ki energy se naye C–C, C–N, C–O ya C–S bonds bana kar do molecules ko jorte hain.

book_ref.quote: These enzymes catalyse the reactions in which two molecules join
